noteEn.meaning: to support something or give it a strong base.

noteEs.exampleTr: Las exportaciones sólidas sustentan la economía.

noteHi.exampleTr: मज़बूत निर्यात अर्थव्यवस्था को सहारा देते हैं।
noteHi.usage: अमूर्त बातों के लिए; underpin growth।

noteJa.exampleTr: 堅調な輸出が経済を支えている。
noteJa.usage: 抽象的な物事に使う。underpin growth。

example.en: Strong public services underpin a fair society.
example.zh: 健全的公共服務是公平社會的基礎。

note.usage: 常用於抽象事物：A underpins B 表示 A 是 B 的基礎；多見於正式寫作。

noteEn.meaning: to support something and make it possible.
noteEn.usage: Formal: 'A underpins B' means A is the base of B.

noteEs.exampleTr: Unos servicios públicos sólidos sustentan una sociedad justa.
noteEs.meaning: sustentar; ser la base de algo.
noteEs.usage: Registro formal: A underpins B = A es la base de B.

noteHi.exampleTr: मज़बूत सार्वजनिक सेवाएँ एक न्यायपूर्ण समाज का आधार हैं।
noteHi.meaning: किसी चीज़ को आधार या सहारा देना।
noteHi.usage: औपचारिक लेखन में: A underpins B = A, B का आधार है।

noteJa.exampleTr: 充実した公共サービスが公正な社会を支えている。
noteJa.meaning: 〜を下支えする；〜の基盤となる。
noteJa.usage: 抽象的な事柄に使う硬い表現。A underpins B＝AがBの土台。

noteKo.exampleTr: 탄탄한 공공 서비스가 공정한 사회를 뒷받침한다.
noteKo.usage: 격식체에서 추상적인 대상에 쓴다. A underpins B = A가 B의 토대이다.

unveiled.en: shown to the public for the first time
unveiled.ex: A new statue was unveiled today.

up.en: used in phrasal verbs like warm up and pick up
up.ex: It will warm up later today.

using.ex: Using a map helped us find the hotel.

view.en: an opinion; (with a view to) aiming to
view.ex: They bought land with a view to building homes.
view.ja: 意見；（with a view to：〜する目的で）
view.zh: 看法；（with a view to：為了）

were.ex: The roads were busy this morning.

which.en: used to add information about a thing

wholesale.en: about selling goods in large amounts to shops
wholesale.ex: Wholesale vegetable prices fell this week.

work.en: something made by an artist; also a job (work and classes = 上班上課)
work.ex: This painting is a work of art.

workers.ex: The workers asked for more pay.

working.ex: He enjoys working with young people.

would.en: used for possible or future situations
would.ex: A new road would help the town.

paragraphs: BWG is a big Irish food company. It runs more than 1,000 shops, like Spar, Mace and Londis. Now it plans to spend €300 million by 2030.
More than €150 million will go to the shops. Many shops will get new fresh food areas. The company also wants to buy more shops.
BWG will build a large new food centre in Dublin. It will open in 2028. A new depot in Sligo will open in 2027.

The company will also spend €30 million on computers and new technology. BWG has more than 2,150 workers. Another 23,000 people work in its shops. Its boss says the plan will make the company stronger.
sentZh: BWG是一家大型愛爾蘭食品公司。
它經營超過一千家商店，例如Spar、Mace和Londis。
現在它計畫在2030年前花費3億歐元。
超過1.5億歐元將用在商店上。
許多商店將增設新的生鮮食品區。
公司也想買下更多商店。
BWG將在都柏林建造一座大型新食品中心。
它將於2028年啟用。
斯萊戈的一座新倉庫將於2027年啟用。
公司也將花3000萬歐元在電腦和新技術上。
BWG有超過2150名員工。
另有兩萬三千人在它的商店工作。
公司老闆說，這項計畫會讓公司更強大。

paragraphs: BWG, the company behind Spar, Mace and Londis shops, plans to spend €300 million to help it grow until 2030. The money will pay for new food centres, better shops and new technology.

BWG and its shop owners will spend more than €150 million on hundreds of store projects. The group has more than 1,000 shops in Ireland. It wants to buy more shops, and it will bring ideas like fresh food counters and automatic systems from its main Spar shop in south Dublin to other stores.

More than €120 million will go to the part of the business that supplies food to restaurants and other shops. The biggest project is a new national food centre at a business park in Dublin. It will store frozen, chilled and fresh food and should be fully working by the middle of 2028. A new depot in Collooney, County Sligo, will open in 2027.
Another €30 million will go on digital technology, including artificial intelligence. This year BWG also bought three food brands, including O'Briens Cafe and Abrakebabra.
BWG started in 1960 and earns about €1.7 billion a year. It is owned by a South African company and employs more than 2,150 people directly.
sentZh: 經營Spar、Mace和Londis商店的BWG公司，計畫花費3億歐元以推動其成長至2030年。
這筆錢將用於新的食品中心、更好的商店和新技術。
BWG和旗下店主將在數百個門市計畫上花費超過1.5億歐元。
該集團在愛爾蘭有超過一千家商店。
它想買下更多商店，並將把南都柏林主力Spar門市的生鮮櫃檯和自動化系統等構想推廣到其他門市。
超過1.2億歐元將投入為餐廳和其他商店供應食品的業務部門。
最大的計畫是在都柏林一座商業園區內新建的全國食品中心。
它將儲存冷凍、冷藏和生鮮食品，預計在2028年年中全面運作。
位於斯萊戈郡科盧尼的新倉庫將於2027年啟用。
另有3000萬歐元將用於數位技術，包括人工智慧。
今年BWG也買下了三個餐飲品牌，包括O'Briens Cafe和Abrakebabra。
BWG創立於1960年，每年營收約17億歐元。
它由一家南非公司持有，直接僱用超過2150人。

paragraphs: Wholesale and retail group BWG, which operates the Spar, Eurospar, Mace, Londis and XL brands, has unveiled plans to invest €300 million to support its growth up to 2030. The strategy covers new distribution centres, an upgrade of its store network and investment in technology.

BWG and its retailers intend to spend more than €150 million on hundreds of store development projects across a network of over 1,000 shops. The group will also pursue acquisitions and roll out fresh food and automation ideas first tested at its flagship Spar in south Dublin.

A further €120 million will go towards its food service and wholesale operations, with the aim of adding €200 million in food service sales by 2030. The centrepiece is a new national food distribution centre at Nexus Logistics Park in Dublin, due to be fully operational by mid-2028. A €20 million multi-temperature depot will also open in Collooney, County Sligo, next year.

A €30 million digital programme, using data, automation and artificial intelligence, underpins the plan. Chief executive John Moane said the strategy set a clear direction for the next phase of growth and would make the business more resilient.
BWG, owned by South Africa's Spar Group, has annual revenue of about €1.7 billion and directly employs more than 2,150 people.
sentZh: 經營Spar、Eurospar、Mace、Londis和XL品牌的批發零售集團BWG，公布了投資3億歐元以支持其至2030年成長的計畫。
這項策略涵蓋新的物流中心、門市網絡升級以及技術投資。
BWG和旗下零售商打算在超過一千家門市的網絡中，於數百個門市開發計畫上花費超過1.5億歐元。
集團也將尋求收購，並推廣最早在南都柏林旗艦Spar門市試行的生鮮食品和自動化構想。
另外1.2億歐元將投入其餐飲服務和批發業務，目標是在2030年前增加2億歐元的餐飲服務銷售額。
核心計畫是位於都柏林Nexus物流園區的新全國食品物流中心，預定2028年年中全面運作。
一座耗資2000萬歐元的多溫層倉庫也將於明年在斯萊戈郡科盧尼啟用。
一項運用數據、自動化和人工智慧、耗資3000萬歐元的數位計畫是整體方案的基礎。
執行長John Moane說，這項策略為下一階段的成長定下明確方向，並將使企業更有韌性。
由南非Spar集團持有的BWG年營收約17億歐元，直接僱用超過2150人。

paragraphs: BWG, the wholesale and retail group behind the Spar, Eurospar, Mace, Londis and XL brands, has earmarked €300 million to underpin its expansion through to 2030, spanning new distribution hubs, a revamp of its store estate and fresh technology.

Upwards of €150 million is to be ploughed into hundreds of store development projects across its network of more than 1,000 outlets. The group also intends to pursue further acquisitions and replicate the fresh food and automation concepts piloted at its flagship Spar in south Dublin.

More than €120 million has been set aside to overhaul its food service and wholesale arm, with a view to boosting food service sales by €200 million. The linchpin is a vast national distribution centre at Nexus Logistics Park in Dublin, slated to be fully operational by mid-2028, alongside a €20 million depot in Collooney, County Sligo.

A €30 million digital transformation harnessing data, automation and artificial intelligence underpins the blueprint. Chief executive John Moane said it charted a clear course for the next phase of growth and would leave the group more resilient.
Founded in 1960 and now owned by South Africa's Spar Group, BWG generates annual revenue of roughly €1.7 billion and directly employs over 2,150 people.
sentZh: 擁有Spar、Eurospar、Mace、Londis和XL品牌的批發零售集團BWG已撥出3億歐元，支撐其至2030年的擴張，範圍涵蓋新物流樞紐、門市全面翻新及新技術。
超過1.5億歐元將投入其一千多家門市網絡中的數百個門市開發計畫。
集團也打算進一步收購，並複製在南都柏林旗艦Spar門市試行的生鮮食品與自動化概念。
已撥出超過1.2億歐元全面改造其餐飲服務與批發部門，目的在於讓餐飲服務銷售額增加2億歐元。
關鍵是位於都柏林Nexus物流園區的大型全國物流中心，預定2028年年中全面運作，另外還有位於斯萊戈郡科盧尼、耗資2000萬歐元的倉庫。
一項利用數據、自動化與人工智慧、耗資3000萬歐元的數位轉型是這份藍圖的基礎。
執行長John Moane表示，這為下一階段成長規劃了清楚的路線，並將讓集團更具韌性。
BWG創立於1960年，現由南非Spar集團持有，年營收約17億歐元，直接僱用超過2150人。

paragraphs: BWG, the wholesale and retail group that operates the Spar, Eurospar, Mace, Londis and XL brands, has announced a substantial €300 million investment programme designed to sustain its growth until 2030. The strategy encompasses new distribution infrastructure, the modernisation of its retail network and technological development.

In excess of €150 million will be allocated to hundreds of store development projects across more than 1,000 outlets. Furthermore, the group intends to expand through acquisitions and to replicate innovations in fresh food and automation that were initially trialled at its flagship store in south Dublin.

Over €120 million will be devoted to transforming its food service and wholesale operations, with the objective of generating an additional €200 million in food service sales. The principal component is a large national distribution centre in Dublin, which is anticipated to be fully operational by mid-2028, complemented by a new depot in County Sligo.

A €30 million digital transformation, incorporating data analytics, automation and artificial intelligence, underpins the entire strategy. According to chief executive John Moane, these investments will consequently render the organisation more resilient.
BWG, which is owned by South Africa's Spar Group, generates approximately €1.7 billion in annual revenue and directly employs over 2,150 people.

主要部分是都柏林一座大型全國物流中心，預計於2028年年中全面運作，並輔以斯萊戈郡的一座新倉庫。
一項結合數據分析、自動化和人工智慧、耗資3000萬歐元的數位轉型，是整體策略的基礎。
執行長John Moane表示，這些投資將因此使組織更具韌性。
由南非Spar集團持有的BWG年營收約17億歐元，直接僱用超過2150人。
